name: @pipeworx/mcp-census-trade

tools.name: census_imports
tools.description: Search US import data by HS commodity code and/or country. Returns import values, quantities, and commodity details. Pass `country` as a plain English name (e.g. "China"). Omit hs_code for total imports from a country; omit country for all countries combined.

hs_code.description: HS commodity code at 2, 4, or 6 digit level (e.g., "8471" for computers, "87" for vehicles). Optional — omit for total imports across all commodities.

country.description: Country name in plain English (e.g., "Mexico", "South Korea", "European Union"). Preferred over country_code — this is resolved for you. Optional — omit for all countries combined.

country_code.description: Census Schedule C country code if you already have one (e.g., "5700" China, "2010" Mexico). NOT an ISO code — "MX" and "CN" will not work. Prefer `country` and pass a name instead. Optional.

month.description: Trade month 01-12 (e.g., "06" for June). Optional — omit for annual data.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return (default 20)

tools.name: census_exports
tools.description: Search US export data by HS commodity code and/or country. Returns export values, quantities, and commodity details. Pass `country` as a plain English name (e.g. "Mexico"). Omit hs_code for total exports to a country; omit country for all countries combined.

hs_code.description: HS commodity code at 2, 4, or 6 digit level (e.g., "8471" for computers). Optional — omit for total exports across all commodities.

country.description: Country name in plain English (e.g., "Mexico", "South Korea", "European Union"). Preferred over country_code — this is resolved for you. Optional — omit for all countries combined.

country_code.description: Census Schedule C country code if you already have one (e.g., "5700" China, "2010" Mexico). NOT an ISO code — "MX" and "CN" will not work. Prefer `country` and pass a name instead. Optional.

month.description: Trade month 01-12. Optional — omit for annual data.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return (default 20)

tools.name: census_trade_balance
tools.description: Check US trade balance with a specific country for a given year. Returns net trade value and breakdown by end-use commodity category.

country.description: Country name in plain English (e.g., "Mexico", "China"). Preferred — resolved for you. Pass this OR country_code.

country_code.description: Census Schedule C country code (e.g., "5700" China, "2010" Mexico). NOT an ISO code. Prefer `country`.

tools.name: census_trade_trends
tools.description: Monthly US trade trends with ONE trading partner — month-by-month imports and exports for a country, optionally narrowed to an HS commodity, to show seasonality and shifts. A country is required: an unfiltered monthly query spans every partner and the Census API cannot return it in time. For all-countries totals use census_imports / census_exports instead.

hs_code.description: HS commodity code. Optional — omit for aggregate trade.

country.description: Country name in plain English (e.g., "Mexico"). Preferred — resolved for you. REQUIRED unless you pass country_code.

country_code.description: Census Schedule C country code (e.g. "5700" China, "2010" Mexico). NOT an ISO code. Prefer `country`. Satisfies the country requirement.

start_year.description: Start year (e.g., "2022"). Optional — defaults to the same year as end_year, i.e. a single year. Maximum span 3 years.

end_year.description: End year (e.g., "2024"). Optional — defaults to the last fully-published year (last calendar year; Census publishes on a lag).

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-census-trade forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the census-trade pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
